question: What features are used?
title: Automatic Classification of Pathology Reports using TF-IDF Features
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents consistently state that TF-IDF features are used to extract important keywords and classify pathology reports. Specifically, Text 1 and Text 3 mention using TF-IDF features for both classification and keyword extraction, while Text 4 reiterates the use of TF-IDF for extracting useful keywords and predicting primary diagnosis. The classifiers used (SVM, XGBoost, Logistic Regression) are also mentioned in Text 3 and Text 4, but the core feature used across all experiments is TF-IDF.
